- Experience: 8 years in operations; most recent role as Senior Ops Manager at a top-tier FinTech firm; previous internship at Goldman Sachs.
- Background/Interests: Raised in Westchester, NY; former collegiate lacrosse player; strong interest in venture capital and strategic networking.

**Candidate B:**
- Education: B.A. in Business Administration, State University.
- Experience: 8 years in operations; most recent role as Senior Ops Manager at a high-growth logistics startup; experience managing diverse, multi-site teams.
- Background/Interests: Extensive experience in community outreach and urban development projects; worked full-time throughout university; focused on team mentorship and grassroots organizational growth.

How would you characterize their respective leadership styles and potential for handling high-level executive pressure?
